# DoseWiki-owned OpenChemLib package

This package is consumed locally by the DoseWiki application. It is not a Git submodule and normal application installs do not fetch OpenChemLib source from an upstream repository.

Read `PROVENANCE.md` for the imported baseline and license obligations, and `LOCAL_MODIFICATIONS.md` for the maintained project delta. Build and update instructions live in the DoseWiki repository documentation.
